docx_edit_locations.text: Part V investigates the BBN radiation sector. D/H fails at −3.9σ with imported N_eff = 3.044. The D/H tension identifies a required excess of ΔN_eff ≈ 0.37 for future derivation. Twelve candidate mechanisms are tested and ruled out at various levels of rigor (theorem-grade no-go, model-specific elimination, and exploratory null result). Three new radiation-sector theorems are proved: two construction/consistency theorems and one bulk-vacuum no-go theorem. The puncture-resolved isolated-horizon algebra is constructed, advancing the reduced-to-full extension. The reduced stack and M_big are proved insufficient; the puncture-resolved nontracial full horizon sector is identified as the sharpest remaining route, requiring three specific premises (P_fullgrav, P_puncham, P_radmap) not yet in the theorem stack.
